Subject: Catalyze program - stipend request & timeline

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the intro last week. Olive Labs is finalizing our accelerator application and we'd like to confirm whether Redwood can extend a trial stipend and a short demo commitment as part of the Catalyze cohort package. Our ask is modest: $8k in credits over 3 months and a 30-minute technical demo slot during week 2 of the program.

Attached is our application PDF (accelerator_application.pdf) and a one-page product overview. Fast context: we’re a seed-stage startup building a real-time inference routing layer for edge devices. Typical inference footprint: 40–80M tokens/day in peak tests, bursty patterns with 200–400ms P50 latency targets. We plan to use Redwood for multi-region failover testing and quantization evaluations.

If helpful, I'm happy to share a short milestone plan and a proposed demo agenda. We’re also talking to VentureCo about co-sponsorship — looped in here.

Could you confirm the steps and timeline for a stipend approval? We’re on a tight accelerator schedule and would appreciate a decision by next Monday (9/13).

Best,
Sam Ortega

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the application and the quick context. Short answer: yes, we can move on an $8k credit stipend for a 3-month window, but a couple of operational asks before we finalize:

- Short milestone plan (1 page) showing how credits will be consumed (testing vs prod).
- Confirmation of a 30-minute demo slot and preferred week/day for us to reserve a dev advocate.
- A quick list of datasets/models you plan to run (so we can size the capacity and suggest quantization profiles).

Operationally, I’ll need approval from our Partner Programs lead and Finance to earmark the credits and get a simple SOW in place. Looping Monica (partner programs) and Lauren (rev ops/contracts) on next steps. Monica — can you confirm program budget rules and whether we need an internal promo code or a signed SOW here? Lauren — if this looks standard, can you prepare the SOW draft and a 30-day invoice hold?

Sam — if you can drop the milestone plan and demo availability this afternoon, I’ll push this through and aim for a decision by Mon 9/13 EOD.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Quick check from Partner Programs: Olive looks eligible for the Catalyze stipend per the accelerator cohort criteria (pre-seed to series A, demonstrable product milestone). We typically approve up to $10k credits for cohort partners; $8k is within normal bounds. Two compliance items before I sign off:

1) A signed 1-page SOW (we do a promissory credit with a milestone clause). Lauren — can you drop a SOW template in the shared drive and set the payment terms to net-30 hold with credits applied upon activation?
2) A short security checklist: basic SOC2 attestation or cloud controls doc, and confirmation that no PHI is in the test data. Sam — do you have a SOC2 in progress or any security documentation you can share?

If both are OK, I’ll approve the credit allocation and request Ops to provision an accelerator promo code tied to the deal_id RDW-ACC-2027-045. Also happy to coordinate the demo slot — Marcus, I suggest Wed week 2 (9/22) morning PT for our dev advocate.
